title: Melbourne | AI MLAI buildDay x S&C
location: Stone & Chalk Melbourne Startup Hub, Melbourne VIC 3000
description: Melbourne's AI buildDay. Bring an idea, a project you've been stuck on, or just turn up curious. You get OpenAI credits to power your tools. Build for a few hours, then demo what you created. Starts at 9am but come and go anytime that suits.

title: RUNWAY - Australia's First Startup Gameshow
description: 4 important lessons for founders/startups. Teams of 5 compete in quick-fire challenges: pitch an absurd startup to mock VCs, acquire users on the street, go on a scavenger hunt, and network undercover. Includes rooftop afterparty!

title: VibeHaus: Ship your app using AI and show it to real users
description: Build a working product in 6 hours without getting stuck. Non-technical founders ship working web apps with live engineering support. Walk away with a deployed web app, live link, and complete user flow ready to demo.

title: Genesis IRL Residency Season 3
description: A 4-day invite-only residency bringing together Australia's top founders, creatives, technologists & investors. Co-living experience across 6 themed houses with 100+ builders. Converging industries, connecting dots, and creating sparks.

title: Super Secret Startup Shit ⚡️ Sydney
description: Raw, unfiltered truth about scaling, raising, bootstrapping and building something big. Where hidden magic happens. For bold and brilliant founders. No egos, no tall poppy syndrome. We rise together or we don't rise at all.

title: DDD Outback 2026
description: A classic coding camp adventure with the DDD Brisbane crew in the outback. Fullstack conference with community-selected presentations.
